title: 特斯拉确实把安全的标尺从「撞后保命」推向「不撞才是真安全」,并以辅助驾驶事故率数据作为核心论证——这是对传统汽车安全叙事的一次重要重塑。

content_en: c Leining NEV Today at 15:09 Tesla began to push the automatic collision avoidance function to some AI4 models, which is included in the 2026.27.6 software and FSD supervision version V14.3.9. It is currently open to early test users. Unlike traditional automatic emergency braking, this system can determine the potential risk of a collision while the driver is driving manually. If the system finds that the driver is not paying enough attention and fails to take timely action, or the FSD may be unexpectedly exited, the vehicle can actively enable FSD ​ Expand c Forward Comment 1

The Supreme Court has clarified that damage caused by traffic accidents due to product defects in vehicles, and the parties request the manufacturer or seller to bear compensation liability in accordance with the provisions of Chapter 4 of Part 7 of the Civil Code, the People’s Court should support it. content: c 余亦禾 09月07日 19:50 有车主分享了6月12日郑州高速上的一次险情。 当时驾驶小米yu7,L2辅助驾驶打开在70公里时速正常跟车。行驶过程中小米智驾状态下车辆自行往右偏,往护栏方向靠拢,后面还有大货车。车内一共五个人,驾驶员及时接管,踩刹车、把方向掰回来,才躲过事故。 事后车主和小米技术人员电话沟通。根据通话记录 ​ 展开c 播放视频 https://video.weibo.com/show?fid=1034:5340600329764870 2 4 7

content_en: c Yu Yihe September 07 19:50 A car owner shared a dangerous situation on the Zhengzhou Expressway on June 12. At that time, I was driving Xiaomi Yu7, with L2 assisted driving turned on and following the car normally at a speed of 70 kilometers per hour. During the driving process, the vehicle veered to the right in Xiaomi Smart Driving mode, approaching the guardrail, and there was a large truck behind it. There were a total of five people in the car. The driver took over in time, stepped on the brakes, and reversed direction to avoid the accident. Afterwards, the car owner communicated with Xiaomi technicians on the phone. According to the call record ​ Expand c Play video https://video.weibo.com/show?fid=1034:5340600329764870 2 4 7

title_en_short: Ideal car owner turned on assisted driving and was found solely responsible for the crash claim, but negotiations are still ongoing - Weibo
content: 男子使用辅助驾驶撞车被认定全责。理想车主称在四川驾车赴理塘，启用车辆辅助驾驶功能后，经一处下坡时车辆左偏越实线，撞上对向车后视镜后驾驶员才刹车，交警认定其全责。理想方回应辅助驾驶有局限性，驾驶员须全程接管，事故系驾驶员未及时干预所致，目前双方仍在协商中。
content_zh: 男子使用辅助驾驶撞车被认定全责。理想车主称在四川驾车赴理塘，启用车辆辅助驾驶功能后，经一处下坡时车辆左偏越实线，撞上对向车后视镜后驾驶员才刹车，交警认定其全责。理想方回应辅助驾驶有局限性，驾驶员须全程接管，事故系驾驶员未及时干预所致，目前双方仍在协商中。
content_en: A man who crashed a car using assisted driving was found to be fully responsible. The owner of the ideal car said that he was driving to Litang in Sichuan. After enabling the vehicle's assisted driving function, the vehicle veered to the left and crossed the solid line when going downhill. The driver braked only after hitting the rearview mirror of the oncoming vehicle. The traffic police determined that he was fully responsible. Ideal Party responded that assisted driving has limitations and the driver must take over the entire process. The accident was caused by the driver's failure to intervene in time. The two parties are still negotiating.

content_en: #assisteddrivingisnotautonomousdriving# A serious car accident occurred in Miaoli, Taiwan. After a van driver, a 45-year-old Jiang man and a 36-year-old Tesla woman named Li, collided, they negotiated between the two vehicles. Not long after, a VOLVO driven by a 51-year-old Lin woman used the assisted driving ACC to chase from behind, killing Jiang Nan, Li Li, and a 62-year-old Filipino woman in the van. #ACC assisted driving collision caused 3 deaths#

title_en: This is not a purely objective analysis. A few days ago, the intelligent driving status of a certain brand of vehicle swayed back and forth and finally resulted in a crash.
title_zh_short: 不是拉踩纯客观分析,前几天某个品牌车辆智驾状态来回摇摆最后撞车的原因。
title_en_short: This is not a purely objective analysis.
content: c Mr圆周率 06月07日 10:12 来自 IronAndroid 不是拉踩纯客观分析,前几天某个品牌车辆智驾状态来回摇摆最后撞车的原因。 现象有几个: 1、不是人机共驾导致的。 2、NOA明显是要进入最右侧的匝道 3、第一次发起变道的时候被右侧并排车辆阻挡,所以又试图回撤到原车道 4、在回撤过程中"向右出匝道"的高优先级指令又被触发了,所以又立刻向右发起变道 ​ 展开c 1 7 24
content_zh: c Mr圆周率 06月07日 10:12 来自 IronAndroid 不是拉踩纯客观分析,前几天某个品牌车辆智驾状态来回摇摆最后撞车的原因。 现象有几个: 1、不是人机共驾导致的。 2、NOA明显是要进入最右侧的匝道 3、第一次发起变道的时候被右侧并排车辆阻挡,所以又试图回撤到原车道 4、在回撤过程中"向右出匝道"的高优先级指令又被触发了,所以又立刻向右发起变道 ​ 展开c 1 7 24
content_en: c Mr Pi June 07, 10:12 from IronAndroid This is not a purely objective analysis. A few days ago, the reason why a certain brand of vehicle's intelligent driving status swayed back and forth and finally crashed. There are several phenomena: 1. It is not caused by human-machine co-driving. 2. NOA obviously wanted to enter the ramp on the far right. 3. When the lane change was initiated for the first time, it was blocked by a parallel vehicle on the right, so it tried to retreat to the original lane. 4. During the retreat process, the high-priority command of "exit the ramp to the right" was triggered again, so it immediately initiated a lane change to the right. Expand c 1 7 24
